## `TagPickerPanel`

Pure: the rows and the writes in, picks out. An empty query is the foldable
tree (hover ＋ and ⋯, double-click to rename, drag to reorder or nest, "New
tag" at the foot); a query lists every tag whose path holds it and offers to
create the typed path.

The ⋯ menu (`TagRowMenu`): Rename · Add sub-tag · Icon… (the Material
Symbols picker, in a control panel anchored on the ⋯ as the menu closes) ·
Move out of the parent · Shade children (a parent's `childColors: "ramp"`) ·
the colour swatches · the caller's `rowMenuExtra` · Delete (immediate; hidden
where `canDelete` says no).

Two shapes of use, one component:

- **A carrier's picker** (the defaults — `TagPickerPopover`): a trailing ✓ on
  `selected`, every tag unfolded, the search focused, a created path picked.
- **A filter** (Places' sidebar): `indicator="checkbox"` draws a leading box
  — ✓ `selected`, − `negated` (the name struck through), and a primary − on
  every ancestor of either (derived, never passed);
  `defaultExpanded="roots"`, `autoFocus={false}`, `pickCreated={false}` (a
  new tag carries nothing, so picking it would filter everything out).

A row whose `counts` entry is 0 draws its name faint. The panel's root carries
`data-tag-picker`; its rows are the tree primitive's `[data-tree-id]`.
